mutations.name: applied-never-loaded
mutations.what: the Hub never looks for the result file the installer left

mutations.name: applied-loaded-before-the-lock
mutations.what: the result file is read and removed before the Hub holds the data folder, so a second start of the launcher takes it from the first Hub

patches.old: const applied = createAppliedNote({ directory: manager.hubDirectory, currentVersion: VERSION, installDirectory: path.dirname(BUNDLE_ROOT), log: (line) => manager.log(line) });
patches.new: const applied = createAppliedNote({ directory: manager.hubDirectory, currentVersion: VERSION, installDirectory: path.dirname(BUNDLE_ROOT), log: (line) => manager.log(line) }); await applied.load();

mutations.name: applied-without-the-installation-folder
mutations.what: the Hub does not tell the note where the installation is, so a Hub started by hand behind the marker of an update that stopped halfway reads the result file early

mutations.name: applied-installation-folder-is-the-bundle
mutations.what: the Hub looks for the marker in the folder it lives in (DATGOLD-HUB), where the installer never puts it, and not in the folder above

mutations.name: applied-installation-folder-is-the-data-folder
mutations.what: the Hub looks for the marker in its data folder

mutations.name: state-without-applied
mutations.what: the state of the Hub never says what the last update left

mutations.name: dismiss-route-does-nothing
mutations.what: Dismiss answers but leaves the note

mutations.name: dismiss-route-not-declared
mutations.what: the dismiss route is not one of the POST routes

mutations.name: applied-in-another-folder
mutations.what: the Hub looks for the result file in a folder that is not its data folder

mutations.name: applied-judged-by-another-version
mutations.what: the note is judged against a version that is not the one the Hub is
